WITH session_data AS ( SELECT user_pseudo_id, (SELECT value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'ga_session_id') AS session_id, event_name, event_timestamp, (SELECT COALESCE(value.string_value, CAST(value.int_value AS STRING)) FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'session_engaged') AS session_engaged, (SELECT value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'engagement_time_msec') AS engagement_time_msec FROM `kc-okf-poc-261122.ga4_sample.events` WHERE event_date_dt BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-01-31' ), aggregated AS ( SELECT CONCAT(user_pseudo_id, CAST(session_id AS STRING)) AS session_key, MAX(session_engaged) AS session_engaged, (MAX(event_timestamp) - MIN(event_timestamp)) / 1000000 AS duration_sec, SUM(IFNULL(engagement_time_msec, 0)) / 1000 AS eng_sec, COUNTIF(event_name = 'page_view') AS page_views, COUNTIF(event_name = 'purchase') AS purchases FROM session_data WHERE session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_sessions, COUNTIF(session_engaged = '1') AS engaged_by_param, COUNTIF(duration_sec > 10 OR page_views >= 2 OR purchases > 0) AS engaged_by_duration_sec, COUNTIF(eng_sec > 10 OR page_views >= 2 OR purchases > 0) AS engaged_by_eng_sec FROM aggregated

SELECT ROUND(SUM(daily_rev), 2) AS total_net_revenue_usd, ROUND(AVG(daily_rev), 2) AS avg_daily_revenue_usd FROM ( SELECT event_date_dt, SUM(IFNULL(ecommerce.purchase_revenue_in_usd, 0)) - SUM(IFNULL(ecommerce.refund_value_in_usd, 0)) AS daily_rev FROM `kc-okf-poc-261122.ga4_sample.events` WHERE event_date_dt BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-01-28' GROUP BY event_date_dt )

SELECT event_date_dt AS event_date, ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(ecommerce.purchase_revenue_in_usd, 0)) - SUM(IFNULL(ecommerce.refund_value_in_usd, 0)), 2) AS net_merch_revenue_usd FROM `kc-okf-poc-261122.ga4_sample.events` WHERE event_date_dt BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-01-28' GROUP BY event_date ORDER BY event_date ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(user_pseudo_id, CAST(ep_session.value.int_value AS STRING))) AS total_sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(COALESCE(ep_eng.value.string_value, CAST(ep_eng.value.int_value AS STRING)) = '1', CONCAT(user_pseudo_id, CAST(ep_session.value.int_value AS STRING)), NULL)) AS engaged_sessions FROM `kc-okf-poc-261122.ga4_sample.events` LEFT JOIN UNNEST(event_params) AS ep_session ON ep_session.key = 'ga_session_id' LEFT JOIN UNNEST(event_params) AS ep_eng ON ep_eng.key = 'session_engaged' WHERE event_date_dt BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-01-31' AND ep_session.value.int_value IS NOT NULL AND traffic_source.source != '(data deleted)'

SELECT traffic_source.source AS traffic_source, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(user_pseudo_id, CAST(ep.value.int_value AS STRING))) AS sessions, ROUND( 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(user_pseudo_id, CAST(ep.value.int_value AS STRING))) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(user_pseudo_id, CAST(ep.value.int_value AS STRING)))) OVER (), 2 ) AS session_share_pct FROM `kc-okf-poc-261122.ga4_sample.events` LEFT JOIN UNNEST(event_params) AS ep ON ep.key = 'ga_session_id' WHERE event_date_dt BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-01-31' AND event_name = 'session_start' AND traffic_source.source != '(data deleted)' GROUP BY traffic_source ORDER BY sessions DESC

WITH session_events AS ( SELECT user_pseudo_id, (SELECT value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'ga_session_id') AS session_id, event_timestamp, event_name, (SELECT COALESCE(value.string_value, CAST(value.int_value AS STRING)) FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'session_engaged') AS is_engaged FROM `kc-okf-poc-261122.ga4_sample.events` WHERE event_date_dt BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-01-31' ), session_level AS ( SELECT user_pseudo_id, session_id, -- Criteria 1: Built-in GA4 session_engaged flag MAX(CASE WHEN is_engaged = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_engaged_flag, -- Criteria 2: Explicit definition (duration > 10s, 2+ page_views, or 1+ purchase) (MAX(event_timestamp) - MIN(event_timestamp)) / 1000000 AS duration_seconds, COUNTIF(event_name = 'page_view') AS page_view_count, COUNTIF(event_name = 'purchase') AS purchase_count FROM session_events WHERE session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_pseudo_id, session_id ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_sessions, COUNTIF(is_engaged_flag = 1) AS engaged_sessions_flag, COUNTIF(duration_seconds > 10 OR page_view_count >= 2 OR purchase_count > 0) AS engaged_sessions_criteria, ROUND(COUNTIF(is_engaged_flag = 1) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) AS engagement_rate_flag_pct, ROUND(COUNTIF(duration_seconds > 10 OR page_view_count >= 2 OR purchase_count > 0) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) AS engagement_rate_criteria_pct FROM session_level

WITH session_events AS ( SELECT user_pseudo_id, (SELECT value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'ga_session_id') AS session_id, event_timestamp, event_name, (SELECT COALESCE(value.string_value, CAST(value.int_value AS STRING)) FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'session_engaged') AS is_engaged FROM `kc-okf-poc-261122.ga4_sample.events` WHERE event_date_dt BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-01-31' ), session_level AS ( SELECT user_pseudo_id, session_id, MAX(CASE WHEN is_engaged = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_engaged_flag, (MAX(event_timestamp) - MIN(event_timestamp)) / 1000000 AS duration_seconds, COUNTIF(event_name = 'page_view') AS page_view_count, COUNTIF(event_name = 'purchase') AS purchase_count FROM session_events WHERE session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_pseudo_id, session_id ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_sessions, COUNTIF(is_engaged_flag = 1) AS engaged_sessions_flag, COUNTIF(duration_seconds > 10 OR page_view_count >= 2 OR purchase_count > 0) AS engaged_sessions_criteria, COUNTIF(duration_seconds > 10) AS sessions_duration_gt_10s, COUNTIF(page_view_count >= 2) AS sessions_page_views_gte_2, COUNTIF(purchase_count > 0) AS sessions_with_purchase FROM session_level

WITH session_events AS ( SELECT user_pseudo_id, (SELECT value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'ga_session_id') AS session_id, event_timestamp, event_name, (SELECT COALESCE(value.string_value, CAST(value.int_value AS STRING)) FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'session_engaged') AS is_engaged FROM `kc-okf-poc-261122.ga4_sample.events` WHERE event_date_dt BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-01-31' ), session_level AS ( SELECT user_pseudo_id, session_id, -- Standard GA4 logged parameter MAX(CASE WHEN is_engaged = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_engaged_flag, -- Metric definition rules: duration > 10s, >= 2 page views, or >= 1 purchase (MAX(event_timestamp) - MIN(event_timestamp)) / 1000000 AS duration_seconds, COUNTIF(event_name = 'page_view') AS page_views, COUNTIF(event_name = 'purchase') AS purchases FROM session_events WHERE session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_pseudo_id, session_id ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_sessions, COUNTIF(is_engaged_flag = 1) AS engaged_sessions_ga4_flag, ROUND(COUNTIF(is_engaged_flag = 1) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) AS engagement_rate_flag_pct, COUNTIF(duration_seconds > 10 OR page_views >= 2 OR purchases > 0) AS engaged_sessions_rule_criteria, ROUND(COUNTIF(duration_seconds > 10 OR page_views >= 2 OR purchases > 0) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) AS engagement_rate_criteria_pct, COUNTIF(duration_seconds > 10) AS sessions_duration_gt_10s, COUNTIF(page_views >= 2) AS sessions_page_views_gte_2, COUNTIF(purchases > 0) AS sessions_with_purchase FROM session_level
